headword: {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}
gloss: overseas travel; international travel; trip abroad

definitions.gloss: overseas travel; international travel; trip abroad
definitions.explanation: Travel to a foreign country, as opposed to domestic travel.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めての{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}は{緊張|きんちょう}した。
examples.english: I was nervous on my first overseas trip.

examples.japanese: {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}にはパスポートが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need a passport for overseas travel.

examples.japanese: {円安|えんやす}の{影響|えいきょう}で{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}の{費用|ひよう}が{以前|いぜん}より{高|たか}くなっている。
examples.english: Due to the weak yen, the cost of overseas travel has become higher than before.

notes:
Composed of {海外|かいがい} (overseas) + {旅行|りょこう} (travel). One of the most commonly used travel-related compounds in Japanese. Frequently appears in travel agency advertising, insurance products, and everyday conversation about vacation plans.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}に{行|い}く — go on an overseas trip
- {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}{保険|ほけん} — overseas travel insurance
- {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}が{好|す}き — like traveling abroad
- {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}の{準備|じゅんび} — preparation for overseas travel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国内旅行|こくないりょこう} — domestic travel; the counterpart for travel within Japan
- {渡航|とこう} — traveling abroad; more formal and administrative, used in official contexts like visa applications
- {外遊|がいゆう} — foreign tour; a formal term, often used for official or diplomatic trips abroad
